Name: Adriel the Meholathite
Summary: Adriel the Meholathite married Merab, Saul's elder daughter, after Saul broke his promise to give her to David. Years later five of Merab's sons by Adriel were handed to the Gibeonites in atonement for Saul's bloodguilt.
KeyStory: Adriel married the princess David was promised, and his sons later paid for Saul's sins.
LifeLesson: Promises broken by kings fall hardest on the families caught between them.
